Captain Osric asks you to clear the road to [[Borlis Pass (outpost)|Borlis Pass]] so the [[Ascalon]]ians can advance safely.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = prophecies
}}

===Objectives===
* Follow the road from [[Yak's Bend]] to [[Borlis Pass (outpost)|Borlis Pass]]. Defeat all [[Stone Summit]] raiders along the road.
* Return to [[Captain Osric]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 500 [[Experience]]
* 100 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)
* [[Frost Artifact]]
** Energy +7 (req. 5 water magic)
** [[Armor]] +5 (vs. [[elemental damage]])
** [[HSR|Halves skill recharge]] of [[spells]] (Chance: 10%)

==Walkthrough==
Enter [[Traveler's Vale]] and follow the quest markers along the road to [[Borlis Pass (outpost)|Borlis Pass]]. At each marker, there will be a group of two or three [[Stone Summit]] dwarves who must be killed to reveal the next marker. Advance carefully, especially if you have other quests active in the area, [[pull]]ing foes if necessary to avoid [[Aggro|over-aggro]]. Once all nine groups have been killed, you can return to [[Yak's Bend]] to claim the reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Captain Osric
:''"The road is swarming with Dwarves!"''
:''"Deldrimor's children were once friends of Ascalon, but there seems to be some new group, the Stone Summit, who have no interest in peace with men. We must put these Dwarves back on their heels if we are to escort so many children and civilians to the pass."''

:''"If you can wipe out the '''Stone Summit raiders''' who are marauding along the road, we can finally begin our journey through these mountains in earnest."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I will do what I can.
| decline = Perhaps you should send a larger force.
| ask = Even as we speak, my commanders are preparing to make a push, escorting one of our caravans southwest into the pass. I need you to scour the '''road to Borlis Pass and wipe out all the Stone Summit raiders.'''
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Captain Osric
:''"I can see Prince Rurik spoke the truth when he praised you so highly. I will need to stay here to provide safe harbor to Ascalonians who wish to follow the Prince's exodus, but we will begin escorting people to Borlis Pass immediately."''

==Notes==
* The quest [[Shiverpeak Stragglers]] will spawn a clump of about a dozen Stone Summit dwarves in the middle of this quest's path. They can be engaged with careful [[pull]]ing or a strong party, but it is easiest to circle around using the eastern path and complete Shiverpeak Stragglers first, causing most of these additional foes to move south and out of the way.
* [[The Way is Blocked]] takes place at the end of this quest's path, so it can be convenient to do both quests together if you can handle the additional [[Snow Ettin]]s spawned by The Way is Blocked.
